description: 2026 MSP belge - Zones énergie, câbles et pipelines is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Institut royal des Sciences naturelles de Belgique (IRSNB). Coverage: Institut royal des Sciences naturelles de Belgique (IRSNB). The portal shows the English title as "2026 Belgian MSP - Energy, cable and pipeline zones" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Institut royal des Sciences naturelles de Belgique (IRSNB). Its keywords include Federale Overheid, Marine Spatial Plan, Reporting INSPIRE, Gouvernement Fédéral, Federal government, Bundesregierung. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XML. The listing shows 2026-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
